pages.text: Wear in a Curios $(thing)hands$() slot to climb frozen surfaces: snow blocks, ice, packed ice, blue ice, frozen obsidian, frozen dirt and frozen sand.$(li)Hold $(thing)Jump$() at a wall to climb$(li)Hold $(thing)Sneak$() to stay put$(li)Let go to drop
Hollows still win any argument about movement.
Acheronite shards, iron and leather. Dr. Vasik's notes: three teams lost fingers before someone added grips. ORSA classified the design, then lost the file.
